name: SpicyChat
summary: Character roleplay with a huge community library, a genuinely testable free tier (avatar generation included), tiered context, Semantic Memory 2.0, and paid TTS at the top tier.
ranking_rationale: Official plans-and-features support article documents the full tier table — context tokens, memory tools, image generation, TTS — and the subscribe page shows $5.95. The free tier includes avatar generation, so it can be evaluated before paying. Downweighted slightly by TTS being locked to the top tier and the absence of a currently supported native iOS app.
